record.paper_title: Open problems on structure of positively curved projective varieties
record.original_question: Let (X,g) be a compact Kähler manifold with semi-positive holomorphic sectional curvature. Is the fundamental group of X an extension of a finite group by ℤ^{2m}? After replacing X by an appropriate finite étale cover X* and considering the Albanese map α: X* → Alb(X*) with fiber F, does F admit a Kähler metric g_F such that ntf(F,g_F)=dim F, and is F projective and rationally connected?

evidence.quote: The same conclusion can be expected even when X is a compact Kähler manifold, but it is still an open problem.
Problem 3.6 (cf. [39, Problem 5.2]). — Let (X, g) be a compact Kähler manifold with semi-positive holomorphic sectional curvature.
Is the fundamental group of X is an extension of a finite group by Z⊕2m?
Does the fiber F admit a Kähler metric gF such that ntf(F, gF ) = dim F?
Is the fiber F projective and rationally connected?

artifact.self_contained_problem:
Let $(X,g)$ be a compact Kähler manifold whose holomorphic sectional curvature is semi-positive, meaning $H(v) := R(v,\bar v, v, \bar v) \geq 0$ for every nonzero $(1,0)$-tangent vector $v$ on $X$. For a Kähler manifold $(Y, g_Y)$, let $\mathrm{ntf}(Y, g_Y)$ denote the maximal complex dimension, over points $y \in Y$, of a subspace of $T^{1,0}_y Y$ on which the holomorphic sectional curvature is not truly flat (i.e., the maximal dimension of a subspace consisting of vectors $v$ that are not null directions of the curvature tensor in every direction).

Address the following:

(a) Is $\pi_1(X)$ an extension of a finite group by $\mathbb{Z}^{2m}$ for some integer $m \geq 0$? Equivalently, does there exist a short exact sequence
$$ 1 \longrightarrow \mathbb{Z}^{2m} \longrightarrow \pi_1(X) \longrightarrow G \longrightarrow 1$$
with $G$ a finite group?

(b) After replacing $X$ by a suitable finite étale cover $X^*$, let $\alpha : X^* \to \mathrm{Alb}(X^*)$ be the Albanese map and let $F$ denote a smooth fiber of $\alpha$. Does $F$ admit a Kähler metric $g_F$ with $\mathrm{ntf}(F, g_F) = \dim F$, and is $F$ a projective and rationally connected manifold?
artifact.category_tag: Kähler manifolds with positive holomorphic sectional curvature
artifact.status_search_result: In the projective case analogous results are known (Yang, Heier–Wong, Matsumura), but in the general compact Kähler setting the conjecture is explicitly stated as open. Recent work (e.g. Matsumura and collaborators around 2023–2024) addresses related splitting/Albanese-fibration results under stronger hypotheses, but the full statement on the fundamental group structure and on rational connectedness of Albanese fibers in the Kähler (non-projective) case remains unresolved.

status_evidence.title: Structure theorem for compact Kähler manifolds with nonnegative holomorphic sectional curvature
status_evidence.snippet: For a compact Kähler manifold with semi-positive holomorphic sectional curvature, a finite étale cover is a fiber bundle over the Albanese torus with rationally connected fiber under additional hypotheses; the general case remains open.
status_evidence.claim: The general Kähler version of the structure theorem (including rational connectedness of Albanese fibers and the fundamental-group statement) is still open.

status_evidence.title: Open problems on structure of positively curved projective varieties (zbMATH)
status_evidence.snippet: Problem 3.6 lists these questions as open problems for compact Kähler manifolds with semi-positive holomorphic sectional curvature.
status_evidence.claim: The problem is explicitly posed as open.
